title: The Ashline Working Register
narrativeText: A working register keeps the steps, not just the answers. This case is number work with the middle shown: place value, the four operations, fractions and percentages, measures and money, shape, charts and proportion. Some questions take one step and some take several, and the other answers on offer are the ones a careful person really does reach. If one of those catches you, the register tells you which step went sideways.
